name: event_id
description: Unique identifier for the telemetry event

name: user_role
description: Role of the actor: lecturer, moderator, qa, or system

name: stage
description: Workflow stage: blueprint, pool, review, assembly, moderation, export

name: event_type
description: Category of event: stage_start, stage_complete, flag_raised, flag_resolved, item_edited, paper_approved

name: flag_type
description: Type of review flag if applicable: key_mismatch, ambiguous, item_flaw, duplicate_past, duplicate_pool, misaligned_clo, bloom_doubt

name: resolution
description: Resolution of flag: accepted, dismissed, edited

name: meta
description: Arbitrary metadata payload for the event
